requirements.label: School mathematics for information systems and IT
requirements.details: The specific entry rule is a credit in SPM Mathematics, B in UEC Mathematics, or an equivalent qualification. For STPM, A levels, matriculation or foundation and a Level 4 non-computing diploma or equivalent, an applicant with only a mathematics pass must enrol in and pass a mathematics enhancement course at the beginning.

requirements.label: Mathematics bridging route
requirements.details: Applicants with arts-stream STPM, A levels, matriculation or foundation, or an MQF Level 4 science and technology diploma (or equivalent) who lack SPM Additional Mathematics may qualify with credits in mathematics and a science, technology or engineering subject at SPM level or equivalent. They must enrol in and pass the mathematics enhancement subject at the start.
